longDescription:
Task Coach is an open source todo manager to manage personal tasks and todo lists. It supports composite tasks, i.e. tasks within tasks. In addition, Task Coach allows you to categorize your tasks, track efforts against a budget per task, and much more. Task Coach is available for Windows, Mac OS X, BSD, Linux, iPhone and iPad.

Your database may be synchronized across these platforms. If espeak is installed, reminders can be spoken.
